subject: Clarify AWS Marketplace metering & entitlement details for SOW — ClearBlue Analytics
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearblue.ai>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:14:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace metering + SOW questions

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team at ClearBlue is excited about moving forward with Redwood via AWS Marketplace. Procurement asked me to confirm two integration points before we sign the SOW:

1) Metering events: can you confirm the exact AWS Metering/usage event payload you expect from our SaaS? We need an example to align our billing system.
2) Entitlement mapping: we have seat-based licensing today — what's the recommended mapping to AWS entitlements to avoid double-billing?

I've attached our internal pricing sheet and a sample of our telemetry so your engineers can validate. Procurement may also want the contract to include a short clause about billing reconciliation cadence.

Can you loop in whoever handles metering/fulfillment? Happy to set a quick call.

Thanks,
Sanjay
VP of Finance — ClearBlue Analytics
Attachments: clearblue_pricing.xlsx (spreadsheet), telemetry_sample.ndjson (sample)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearblue.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering + SOW questions

Sanjay — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Kimberly (Marketplace lead) and Aditya (Billing/Integrations) who will confirm the technical expectations.

Short answers up-front:
- We support both SaaS metering (usage events) and entitlement activation paths; for seat-based products we commonly recommend an entitlement + usage hybrid so customers don't get double-charged.
- Our SOW includes a monthly reconciliation cadence by default, with a 30-day window for upfront adjustments.

Kimberly/Aditya — can you review the attached sample and confirm if the payload aligns with our required fields? Also adding a draft SOW (v3) that procurement can review.

Sanjay — can you confirm the expected cadence for usage events from your side (per-minute, per-hour, batched daily)? That will affect recommended batching and the cost profile.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Ops — Redwood Inference
Attachments: clearblue_pricing.xlsx (as received), clearblue_sow_draft_v3.pdf

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearblue.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 11:33:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering + SOW questions

Thanks Laura. Sanjay — quick technical notes from the Marketplace/ops side:

1) Required metering fields: we need a JSON payload for each usage event that includes at minimum: customer_entitlement_id, timestamp (ISO8601), unit_type (tokens / seats / api_calls), quantity, and a signature header for authenticity. We'll review your telemetry sample and note a few field-name mismatches.

2) Entitlement mapping options (recommended):
- Option A (recommended): Publish a single entitlement SKU for ClearBlue seat license and send periodic usage events that increment a "active_seats" metric. Redwood will treat entitlement as the authoritative seat cap; overages are reported via usage events.
- Option B: Map each seat to an AWS entitlement instance (higher bookkeeping overhead) — we generally avoid this unless customers require per-seat entitlements for compliance.

3) Reconciliation: our default is monthly; we can support weekly if you prefer but that may increase operational overhead and cost.

I've attached a small example payload and a short checklist (aws_metering_payload_examples.json). Aditya — please confirm the doc-signing and billing trigger language we should ask procurement to accept.

-kim
Kimberly Park
Marketplace Partnerships — Redwood Inference
Attachments: aws_metering_payload_examples.json (payload example)

From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay@clearblue.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearblue.ai>, Emily Chen <emily.chen@clearblue.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace metering + SOW questions

Kim/Laura — this is great and very actionable. A few answers:

- Usage cadence: we'll emit batched usage events every 15 minutes and can provide an end-of-day rollover batch if that helps your ingestion.
- Entitlement approach: procurement prefers Option A (single entitlement SKU + active_seats metric). That aligns with our internal billing and keeps customer experience simpler.
- Reconciliation: monthly is fine. We'll accept a 30-day adjustment window.

I've attached our revised SOW comments and a DocuSign powerform link for the final SOW once legal confirms.
